**Discpress 1.8.1 adds a compatibility mode for older emulators**, for PS2 games on DVD that AetherSX2, NetherSX2 or an older PCSX2 won't open.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.8.1/discpress.html)** (about 3 MB): the whole app in one file you keep. If you use the downloaded file, download it again for this version.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad. It updates itself.

## Compatibility mode for older emulators

- **Settings → Compatibility mode for older emulators** makes PS2 games on DVD into CD CHDs, the only kind AetherSX2, NetherSX2 and PCSX2 builds from before April 2023 read. They are about 7–10% larger, and newer emulators read them too. It replaces the setting "PlayStation 2 DVD games": if you had chosen CD CHDs there, the mode is on.
- **With the mode on, the Zstd presets warn for every console** that older emulators can't open Zstd CHDs. The compression you pick never changes by itself.
- **Without it,** a PS2 DVD game's card says under Options which emulators need a CD CHD, and how to make one.

CHDs are the same as 1.8.0's, byte for byte the same as chdman 0.289's with the default settings.
